path_base: Paths are relative to the akari-v3.0 directory.
workflow: stepwise image-led exploration: face and hair, then body proportions, then outfits

constraints.legacy_assets: Do not use earlier repository versions
constraints.face_style: Use user-selected P1 Pro image for current facial geometry, soft downturned grey eyes, cheek-mouth balance, black bob, segmented bangs and drawing treatment; no age-label-driven redesign.
constraints.current_full_body_reference: P6 selected full-body integration; B7 retained as original body-construction history.
constraints.leg_and_sock_design_intent: Keep the healthy leg contours and navy ribbed below-knee socks in selected P6, inherited from user-refined B7.
constraints.facial_detail_reference_priority: P1 is the original face/hair/drawing reference; P2 is the selected everyday smile. P4/P5 are approved bust-angle support. P6 is the selected body/outfit and whole-body appearance. Supply original face/expression references directly for future generation.

face.approval: Proのやつ土台にしてみよう

generation_rules: Open the edit target and relevant original references with view_image before generation.
P1 is the primary face/hair/drawing authority; P2 is the everyday smile; P6 is body/outfit only.
Give every input reference an explicit role; use the relevant approved expression as support.
New scene selection never automatically replaces a primary reference.
Do not import older repository versions or the August style-research checkpoint into this design.
history_scope: Original local records contain historical absolute paths. They are provenance, not portable input dependencies. Earlier rejected images are not included; current references and all 25 selected situation outputs are included.
